## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, `.env` values, API keys, or environment dumps included
- [ ] Generated web assets updated only when template or Tailwind changes require them
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests

## Security Checklist

- [ ] Changes touching auth, CSRF, API keys, admin sessions, or webhook/feed-import secrets describe the security impact
- [ ] logs, metrics, errors, or artifacts do not expose secrets, environment values, file contents, or full local paths
- [ ] Changes touching migrations, feed integrity, CI/CD, release, or deployment behavior include the relevant security/CI validation commands
- [ ] `SECURITY.md` updated or not needed
- [ ] `DESIGN.md` updated or not needed
